```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(rstatix)

dfb <- read.csv('output/tables/risultatiBayes.csv')
dfu <- read.csv('output/tables/risultatiUnmarked.csv')
traits <- read.csv('output/tables/odoTraits.csv')
```


```{r}
models <- left_join(dfb,dfu, by = 'species')
tab1 <- left_join(traits,models, by= 'species')

write.csv(tab1,'output/tables/tab1.csv')
```
